observed_mechanism.matching: availability.matches concatenates family/status/reason/required_mod/native_owner and normalizes ASCII lowercase, underscores and hyphens; it has no localized caption or localized reason input
observed_mechanism.caller: runtime.library.update_availability_content passes model_view(...).search to availability.rows; it renders the row as a LocalisedString and discards the ordinary Research translation cache on entry
observed_mechanism.interpretation: Display and search operate on different vocabularies. These observations are deductions from the fixed published source, not screenshots or executed GUI events.
observed_mechanism.preservation: The returned rows are informational only; this witness supplies no evidence about earned research, queued work, bonus, save correctness or functional worker loading.
